EvalBot: nightly-eval alert: suite=math_long_form, failing_cohort=proof_generation, severity=high, delta_exact_match=-32%
Sam H.: saw the alert, loading the top failing samples now :eyes:
Sam H.: summary — redwood-34b-int8-kv2 saw exact-match drop 92% -> 60% on proof_generation cohort between 03:00 and 03:10 UTC
Eva L.: copies of failing outputs?
Sam H.: paste below (trimmed):
```
prompt: Prove that the sum of two even numbers is even.
gold: Let a=2k, b=2m, then a+b=2(k+m) so even.
model(redwood-34b-int8-kv2): "First assume a and b are odd..."
```
Noah K.: that looks like a deterministic flip to contradictory phrasing, not blanking.
Jeni P.: any recent runtime changes? batching or kvcache config?
Sam H.: #infra-deploy shows a canary kernel roll 02:50 that modified batching heuristics (max_batch_size from 16 -> 32) and enabled a new kv-eviction flag on GPU nodes
Mike R.: I pulled per-request headers — these examples are long-prefix proofs (~1200 tokens). kv cache activity spikes in the same window.
Eva L.: hypothesis: int8 kernel + larger batching + kv eviction = incorrectly reused past attention keys for new requests -> token conditioning corruption
Noah K.: agree plausible, especially for longcontext cohorts. Any repro at lower load?
Sam H.: repro command (local dev box, single request):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \  -d '{"model":"redwood-34b-int8-kv2","prompt":"[PROOF PROMPT HERE]","max_tokens":400,"temperature":0.0}'
```
Sam H.: on single-run, model behaves correctly. under load (batch 16) we reproduce the bad output ~30% of runs
Jeni P.: that points to a concurrency/batching bug in runtime rather than quantization math alone
Noah K.: I can create a runtime reproducer: run synthetic load with batch sizes 8/16/32 and watch KV indices + per-request seq ids. I'll run a short job now and post logs
EvalBot: test-run summary (1716234680): batch=16, failure_rate=28%, kv_eviction_events=high, trace_id=trace-1716234680
Noah K.: logs: "KVCache: eviction idx mismatch for request seq 5421 -> using key from seq 5413"
Eva L.: if runtime is wiring wrong keys across requests that would explain contradictory proofs (key order matters for causal attention)
Mike R.: mitigation options: revert canary kernel to previous batching heuristics, or temporarily disable kv-eviction flag. Which is quicker?
Jeni P.: revert canary ASAP for safety. I'll queue a rollback to prior kernel on canary pool and throttle canary traffic to 0%
Sam H.: assigning owners: @Eva L. owns model-impact analysis, @Noah K. owns runtime repro + patch, @Jeni P. owns rollout/rollback. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-4567 created
Eva L.: I'll run targeted evals across quant variants (fp16, int8, int4 if available) to isolate whether quantization amplifies the bug
Noah K.: running repro job now, will post traces and a minimal runtime patch candidate if confirmed
Jeni P.: rollback scheduled in 10m. I'll post deploy id and ETA
Sam H.: initial severity=high, immediate rollback and owner assignments done. keep thread for updates, escalate to eng-sre if failure persists after rollback
Mike R.: noted, adding timeboxed on-call paging if rollback doesn't reduce failure rate by 10:15 UTC
Noah K.: update (1716234805): repro confirms inter-request key reuse under batch>=16 when kv-eviction flag is on. preparing hotfix to tag requests with unique cache namespace as stopgap
Eva L.: thanks — I'll freeze model rollouts for redwood-34b-int8-* variants until we validate
Sam H.: thanks team. next: postmortem checklist after rollback resolution: collect traces, diff kernel changes, run full math_long_form suite at scale, and publish incident summary
Jeni P.: rollback complete (deploy id: canary-2024-02-13-027). monitoring baseline now
EvalBot: post-rollback check (1716234899): suite=math_long_form, exact_match_delta=-3%, failure_rate=2%
Sam H.: closing initial triage — followups on ML-4567. :white_check_mark:
